project_name: Amazon More Connected and Sustainable - Quality and resilient digital infrastructure for the sustainable development of the amazon region
objective: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of federal and subnational governments, as well as Development Finance Institutions (DFIs), to design and implement digital connectivity initiatives that drive sustainable, inclusive, and climate-resilient development across Brazil's Amazon region. Through a programmatic and coordinated approach, the TC will contribute to empowering the Amazon with a transformative connectivity strategy that drives sustainable development, investment and climate action. To that end, the TC will finance: (i) the formulation of a regional strategy for digital connectivity; (ii) the design of quality and resilient digital infrastructure solutions; (iii) the development of innovative financial mechanisms to scale investments; and (iv) the promotion of connectivity uses cases that support decarbonization. The TC will pursue the following specific objectives: (i) support the development of a comprehensive regional strategy to expand digital connectivity across the Brazilian Amazon, ensuring alignment with national and subnational priorities and fostering multi-stakeholder coordination; (ii) design and prepare investment operations and global credit programs in collaboration with national and subnational governments, as well as DFIs, with a focus on mobilizing public and private capital for digital infrastructure; (iii) develop practical use cases and pilot projects that integrate digital connectivity into initiatives aimed at reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, particularly in sectors such as sustainable agriculture, forest monitoring, telemedicine, digital education, and smart logistics.

project_name: Support for the Operational Strategy to Improve Climate Resilience and Risk Management in Transport Infrastructure in Brazil (focus on the Amazon)
objective: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to improve the resilience of the Brazil transport infrastructure, with focus on the Amazon transport network, the national and subnational projects strategic to improve the resilience and redundance of the transport network and, the transport projects in execution and/or preparation with IDB resources. The specific objectives are: (i) a pilot project to design a regional dynamic WRF model to improve the threat information necessary to contribute to develop the adaptive capacity and to reduce the vulnerability to climate risk to the Brazilian transport network; (ii) to develop tools that contribute to asses and reduce climate vulnerability of the Brazilian transport network, and improve institutional capacity, dialogue and coordination among decision makers in transport climate risk management in Brazil and; (iii) to develop a policy and technical roadmap for the development of the Amazonian transport network in Brazil, based on a set of standards of resilience, green infrastructure, and nature based solutions.

project_name: Bioeconomy of Sociobiodiversity: Strategies for Conservation and Sustainable Development of the Territories of Traditional Peoples and Communities in the Face of Climate Change in the Amazon
objective: To strengthen community-based sociobioeconomy enterprises in territories of Indigenous Peoples and Traditional Communities in the Amazon — RESEX Chico Mendes (Acre), Middle Solimões and Lower Juruá (Amazonas), and Marajó (Pará) — through the structuring of business plans, the mobilization of financial instruments, communication strategies, and articulation with markets and public policies, expanding access to credit, investments, and commercialization opportunities, in order to promote income generation, forest conservation, and resilience to climate change.The specific objectives of the project are to:(i) strengthen community organizations and sociobiodiversity businesses in traditional collective-use territories by developing their organizational, administrative, and management capacities, promoting the design and implementation of territorial strategic plans that enhance the economic sustainability of enterprises and access to new market opportunities;(ii) activate the financing ecosystem of sociobiodiversity value chains, strengthening the capacities of community and associative actors to mobilize resources, structure investment projects, attract capital, and establish strategic partnerships that expand access to financial mechanisms and medium- and long-term investments; and(iii) promote the generation, management, and strategic use of knowledge on the sociobioeconomy in traditional collective-use territories, increasing the visibility of sociobiodiversity value chains and strengthening communication channels and engagement with markets, investors, public institutions, and society.

project_name: Integrated urban development and climate resilience in Brazilian cities
objective: This TC aims to support Brazilian cities in designing integrated and resilient urban development projects that promote sustainability and social inclusion. This TC focuses on improving the living conditions of low-income and vulnerable populations through targeted interventions addressing entrenched inequalities and promoting inclusive urban growth. Specifically, this TC will (i) provide technical assistance to municipalities for the design, preparation, and execution of integrated urban development programs, with a focus on sustainability and climate resilience; and (ii) strengthen institutional capacities to ensure projects incorporate technical, environmental, and social analyses, consistent with international and sectoral best practices.

project_name: Bridging Climate Action and Biodiversity Conservation through Bioeconomy towards COP30 - Bio COP30
objective: This technical cooperation (TC) aims to directly support the Presidency of COP30 by providing technical inputs on key aspects of the transition to a low-carbon and climateresilient global economy. It will integrate mitigation, and adaptation approaches by exploring how bioeconomy contributes to sustainable development, with a focus on biodiversity conservation, traditional knowledge, and climate resilience. Additionally, the TC will emphasize the role of carbon accounting, developing methodologies that account for life cycle emissions, align with the realities of countries with clean energy matrices, and support carbon credit generation through sustainable land use and bioenergy production. By addressing both financing and trade challenges, it will provide actionable insights for policymakers, investors, and international organizations, reinforcing the bioeconomy's role in global climate and economic strategies.

project_name: Support for the Modernization Program for Energy Resilience and Sustainability in Santa Catarina
objective: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the operation of the Energy Modernization for Climate Resilience and Sustainability Program in Santa Catarina (BR-L1664) by conducting the necessary economic, environmental, social inclusion, productivity, and legal studies. The specific objectives are: (i) to finance economic, social inclusion, productivity, and legal studies to assess the overall feasibility, sustainability, and enabling framework of the program; (ii) to finance technical and environmental studies that support the technical design of the program and ensure its alignment with the principles of climate sustainability and operational efficiency; and (iii) to finance complementary engineering studies and analyses required for the definition and structuring of the program.

project_name: Strengthening the Federal Government’s institutional planning capacity to implement climate, environmental, and infrastructure policies
objective: This technical cooperation aims to strengthen the Federal Government's institutional planning capacity to implement climate, environmental, and infrastructure policies by enhancing the environmental impact assessment of Multiannual Planning Process (PPA) attributes and establishing guiding criteria for the prioritization of infrastructure investments, considering an environmental and climate-focused approach. The TC will support the integration of mitigation and adaptation targets into public planning, budgeting, and public investment frameworks, as well as strengthen interoperable systems to track policy effectiveness at the national level, in alignment with the Plano Clima.

project_name: Strengthening Climate Mainstreaming and Adaptation Finance in Brazil’s Portfolio
objective: The objective of this Technical Cooperation is twofold: first, to strengthen SEAID's institutional capacity to monitor and assess the climate outcomes of operations reviewed by the Commission for External Financing (COFIEX), with particular emphasis on adaptation and resilience; and second, to leverage the IDB's existing expertise, systems, and operational experience to advance the systematic integration of climate adaptation throughout its operational cycle in Brazil. The operation will develop sector-specific methodologies, tools, and indicators tailored to the Brazilian context, supporting the consistent identification of climate risks, the incorporation of resilience considerations, and the measurement of adaptation outcomes in the design, implementation, and economic and financial assessment of credit operations, while providing SEAID with the technical and diagnostic resources needed to apply climate-related criteria consistently to the operations assessed under the established climate sub-limit. By enhancing SEAID's analytical capabilities and improving the tracking and mobilization of adaptation finance, the TC will expand climate finance for resilience and reinforce the mainstreaming of adaptation across both IDB-supported operations and other externally financed investments in Brazil.
